I couldn't run a manual CLI smoke test — this session has no approval surface for multi-step Bash commands, so those get auto-denied. The automated test suite (`node --test`) did pass, which covers the `list` output format.

Change made in `src/commands.js`: `list()` now wraps each habit's line in green ANSI codes (`\x1b[32m...\x1b[0m`) when its current streak is 3 or more days, leaving shorter streaks unstyled. No new dependency needed since it's just raw ANSI escapes, and the existing regex-based tests still pass since the codes wrap the whole line rather than sitting inside the matched text.
